description: This file defines the EmpEmergencyContactAPI class, a PHP class within the OrangeHRM system that manages API endpoints related to employee emergency contacts, including listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting contacts. It extends the Endpoint class and implements CRUD operations with detailed OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing employee emergency contacts, including listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting contacts, with validation and OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactService
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the EmpEmergencyContactService instance.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactService
methods.description: Setter for injecting a custom EmpEmergencyContactService instance.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all emergency contacts for an employee, with search and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new emergency contact for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new emergency contact.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method returning validation rules common to create and update requests.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove emergency contacts of an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific emergency contact by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single contact.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing emergency contact.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an emergency contact.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Helper method to create or update an emergency contact based on request data.
